flagship.name: My Financier
flagship.summary: A personal finance service: a web app and an Android app sharing the same data.
flagship.task: Design and build a personal finance service from scratch: a web version with a real backend, plus an Android app that works offline and syncs with the web account.
flagship.solution: Built a Laravel API and an SSR Nuxt 3 front end for the web version, plus a native Flutter app with an offline-first architecture. Designed the data model, auth and server infrastructure myself.
features: Nuxt 3 SSR front end, Laravel API backend
Offline-first Android app: Riverpod, Drift, GoRouter
Data sync between the web account and the app
Tuned nginx: keepalive pools to upstream, WebSocket support, SSL session cache
flagship.result: A working product made of two connected clients — web and Android — that's usable every day: my-financier.ru in the browser, and the My Financier app on RuStore.
flagship.moreProducts: More projects in the "Own products" section below

trust.title: Why people trust me with development
trust.subtitle: Specific things I can do and have already done in practice.

item1.title: One developer covers backend, frontend and mobile
item1.description: No need to assemble a team or sync several contractors: backend on Laravel, front end on Nuxt or Next.js, and a mobile app on Flutter — I build it all myself, under one consistent architecture.

item2.title: Production experience with auth and databases
item2.description: OAuth login, PostgreSQL and Redis in a running service, not a learning project.

item3.title: I configure the infrastructure myself
item3.description: Tuned nginx: keepalive pools to upstream, WebSocket support, SSL session cache — I take the server to production, not just the code.

item4.title: Offline-first mobile architecture
item4.description: Apps that work without a connection and sync data once it's back: Riverpod, Drift, GoRouter.

item5.title: Store publishing and follow-through
item5.description: I carry a release all the way to RuStore and Google Play, and stay reachable after it ships.

item6.title: I can join at any stage
item6.description: Ready to run a project from idea to launch end to end, or join development already in progress — extend a backend, add a mobile app, or work through someone else's code.

process.title: How the work goes
process.subtitle: You don't need a detailed spec upfront. Describe the idea and the task — together we'll define what the first version needs.

step1.title: We discuss the task
step1.description: We define the idea, goals and budget, and agree on the scope and timeline for the first iteration.

step2.title: We design the solution
step2.description: I design the architecture and data model and put together an interface prototype, so the outcome is clear before development starts.

step3.title: We build
step3.description: I work in short iterations and show working builds at every stage, not just once at the end.

step4.title: We test and launch
step4.description: I check real usage scenarios, set up the server and CI/CD, and publish the site or app to the stores.

step5.title: We support and grow it
step5.description: I stay reachable after launch: watching stability, wiring up analytics, and growing the product further.

products.title: Own products
products.subtitle: Besides client work, I come up with, launch and grow my own apps — from a finance service to games on the app stores.

my-financier-web.name: My Financier
my-financier-web.description: A personal finance web app: Nuxt 3 on the front end (SSR), a Laravel API, PostgreSQL and Redis underneath. It ships alongside a companion Android app, with data synced between web and mobile.
my-financier-web.note: Paired with a native Android app — My Financier for mobile.
highlights: Nuxt 3 SSR front end, Laravel API backend
Tuned nginx: keepalive pools to upstream, WebSocket support, SSL session cache

my-financier-app.name: My Financier
my-financier-app.description: A native Flutter companion to my-financier.ru, built offline-first — data lives locally and syncs back to the web account.
my-financier-app.note: Works together with the my-financier.ru web service.

glidespark.name: GlideSpark (Парящая искра)
glidespark.description: A neon, one-tap space arcade. Instead of just a leaderboard, you race against 'ghosts' — recorded runs from other players on a track generated from a shared seed, so everyone gets the exact same layout.
highlights: Ghost duels against other players' recorded runs
Seeded generation — you and the ghost race the same track
Global leaderboard and friend challenges; coins are cosmetic-only

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: What people usually ask before starting a project.

item1.question: Can I reach out with just an idea, no spec?
item1.answer: Yes. Describe the task in your own words — together we'll work out what the first version needs, and I'll propose an approach.

item2.question: Can I hire you for just the backend or just an API?
item2.answer: Yes, you can bring me in at any stage: backend only, APIs and integrations only, or work on one specific part of an existing project.

item3.question: Can you extend a project that already exists?
item3.answer: Yes. I'll get familiar with the existing code and architecture and continue from there — no need to start from zero.

item4.question: Do you build mobile apps?
item4.answer: Yes, with Flutter. I publish apps on RuStore and Google Play — the whole way from prototype to release.

item5.question: Can you keep supporting the product after launch?
item5.answer: Yes, I stay reachable after release: fixing issues, extending functionality, and watching server stability.

item6.question: How is the price worked out?
item6.answer: It depends on the scope. After we discuss the project I'll propose an approach along with a timeline and cost estimate for the first iteration.
